description: List the years covered by the index of the Journal Officiel de la République Algérienne (JORA), the official gazette in which Algerian laws, ordinances, decrees and orders are published, from 1962, newest year first. For each year: its number of issues, the last issue number, how many issues have a French and an Arabic edition, and for how many issues UpGrowth holds a summary. For Morocco (country MA) it lists the years of the Bulletin officiel du Royaume du Maroc, the Moroccan official gazette, from 1912: its French and Arabic editions (the French translation edition holds fewer issues) and no summaries. For Tunisia (country TN) it lists the years of the Journal Officiel de la République Tunisienne (JORT), the Tunisian official gazette, from 1956: its French and Arabic editions and no summaries. Use it first, to see which years exist before listing the issues of a year. Without an API key only Algeria answers, and meta.free_years lists the years it may read: the other years need a key. Takes only the optional lang and country.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

name: list_jo_years
title: List Journal Officiel years
